readings.Aries: Rest is not retreat. Your system needs to cycle before it can perform at capacity again. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Taurus: You process change slowly and completely. The speed is not a flaw; the resistance is sometimes. Let this one be easy.
readings.Gemini: The idea you dismissed too quickly deserves another look. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Cancer: The protective instinct you're feeling is accurate. Verify that you're protecting the right thing. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Leo: Someone who loves you is asking for something small. Giving it would cost you almost nothing. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Virgo: The gap between your ideal and the reality is where growth lives. Stop trying to close it and start working in it. Let this one be easy.
readings.Libra: The equanimity you project is partly real and partly effort. Let someone see the effort. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Scorpio: What you've buried hasn't decomposed. It has been waiting. Time to deal with it. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Sagittarius: The freedom you're seeking is available now, in this constraint. Find it. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Capricorn: There's a version of rest you can access without losing anything. Find it. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Aquarius: There is an idea you've been developing privately that needs exposure to become real. Share it. Let this one be easy.
readings.Pisces: Something is converging — threads you've been holding separately are about to become the same thread. Sleep on it before committing.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
